Monopoli 0-0 Napoli - Primavera 2, matchday 7, 31/10/2026

All figures are video-tagging ESTIMATES (xG is a model estimate). Cards/subs: official sheet. No shirt numbers on the sheet: players identified by position or visible number, low-confidence events flagged. The file has a ~20 s cut (37:28-37:47) and ends before the final whistle (93:41).

Notes & caveats

  • All figures are video-tagging ESTIMATES (35 clips tagged by video-analysis subagents, plus a ~20 s cut at 37:28-37:47 and no final whistle in the file: 45:36 / 93:41). Event logs are sparser than the taggers' own COUNT lines in 11 clips (1,748 lines logged vs 1,979 counted), so absolute counts (passes, interceptions, fouls) are lower bounds; ratios (possession %, pass %, PPDA) are less affected.
  • Official cards only: Errico (Monopoli) 31', D'Angelo (Napoli) 35', Turcinskas (Monopoli) 45', Casillo (Monopoli) 85'.
  • UNCONFIRMED (not counted): one tagger (clip H2_25) logged a Napoli yellow card at 68:47; it is not on the official list.
  • Napoli's 28:45 goal (tagged 28:44, clip H1_10) was disallowed for offside: kept as a shot on target (xG 0.20) and also logged as a Napoli offside. Final score 0-0.
  • Directions: ground truth from frames - 1H Monopoli attack RIGHT / Napoli LEFT (black Napoli GK seen in the right goal at ~file 780 s, light-kit Monopoli GK in the left goal at ~426 s); 2H swapped (black-kit GK at the left goal, red Napoli defenders). Each tagger described its own frame in NOTES and many were mirrored vs the briefing: 1H clips H1_02, H1_10, H1_11, H1_16 said Monopoli attacks LEFT; 2H clips H2_20-H2_26, H2_28, H2_30, H2_32, H2_33 said Monopoli attacks RIGHT. Those clips were mirrored (x->105-x, y->68-y) into the canonical frame; all other clips with notes agreed with the truth. Clips without direction notes (H1_00, H1_01, H1_03, H1_05-H1_09) were assumed to follow the briefing (checked against shot/clearance/corner positions, which agree). Mirrored clips: H1_02, H1_10, H1_11, H1_16, H2_20, H2_21, H2_22, H2_23, H2_24, H2_25, H2_26, H2_28, H2_30, H2_32, H2_33. Team-relative coordinates then have each team attacking x=105.
  • Player tables: taggers rarely read names; only names that are on that team's official sheet were kept (32 names from the wrong team's sheet were dropped). Everything else is 'Unattributed'. Shirt numbers are never inferred.
  • xG: per-shot value from the tagger's detail field (xG=...) where given, otherwise a distance/angle model estimate. PPDA = opponent passes with x<=60 / (interceptions + fouls + duels) by the pressing team at x>=40, team-relative.
